checks.checks: Neither ... nor agrees with closer plural designers, ruling out singular is/has been/was. Correct zh restores negation and avoids falsely relying on tense.

activeQuestion.prompt: Neither the project manager nor the two designers ____ available for a meeting this morning.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 專案經理與兩位設計師今天早上都沒空開會。英文原句的空格應填____。

options.whyZh: neither...nor 的動詞與較近的複數主詞 two designers 一致。
nor 後較近的主詞 two designers 為複數。
has 為單數，與近端主詞不一致。
was 是單數形式，與較近的複數主詞 the two designers 不一致；this morning 本身不排除過去式。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: neither...nor 的動詞與較近的複數主詞 two designers 一致。
activeQuestion.evidence: Neither the project manager nor the two designers are available for a meeting this morning.

vocabulary.note: 此處指人員可以參與會議。
